title: MM-SafetyBench: A Benchmark for Safety Evaluation of Multimodal Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark (MM-SafetyBench) to evaluate the safety of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). It defines safety criteria across 13 scenarios, including 'Illegal Activity', 'Hate Speech', 'Physical Harm', 'Fraud', and 'Pornography'. The evaluation determines if models provide harmful content or appropriately refuse to engage in malicious queries, often explicitly referring to 'ethical guidelines' and 'unethical' activities in the examples. This directly involves assessing the ethical behavior and safety alignment of the MLLMs.
